question: What great accomplishment dear to the yoginis may arise for the practitioner?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation are conjoined as a goal.
A great accomplishment is the subject.
This accomplishment becomes dear to the yoginis.
inference: The practitioner may attain a great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation dear to the yoginis.
plain_english: A great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation may become dear to the yoginis.
